text:
nina: Kicking off this week's release train — tag: release-2024.03.1. Canary on api-layer starting at 10% now. Release freeze window: Sat 22:00 PT -> Mon 08:00 PT. Exceptions via #release-requests with approver chain. Plan: https://go.redwood/releases/2024-03-1 :train:
release-bot: Deploy event: service=api-layer, env=canary, tag=release-2024.03.1, canary=10% :white_check_mark:
ash: Quick Q — does this change any model endpoints? Need to update client libs?
nina: No breaking endpoint changes. There is a tuning change to default quantization profile that affects Dedicated clusters using older runtime. We'll ship agent 2.9.0 with compatibility flags. See notes: https://go.redwood/compat-2-9
julian: For Private/on-prem customers, we should send the advisory email with upgrade steps. I'll draft and loop in trust & security.
oncall-pager: Observability: minor 5s tail latency blip in us-east-1 at 17:12 UTC. Tracing shows increased queuing for one pod. Investigating.
ash: Saw the spike. Probably due to traffic burst during canary ramp. CPU on p4d nodes slightly higher.
devtools: Health check for canary: `curl -s https://canary.api.redwood.dev/health` returns "ok"; service version: release-2024.03.1-canary.
release-bot: Canary progress: api-layer 10% -> 30% (2024-03-05T17:30Z). No error budget exceedances detected.
sre-lead: If CPU stays >85% for 15m we throttle ramp and notify. Keep telemetry open.
julian: Drafted Private advisory, including agent 2.9.0 migration steps and rollback commands. Posting to #customer-ops in 10m.
nina: Reminder: smoke suite run required by all owners before we hit 50%. Link: https://go.redwood/smoke-suite. Drop a :thumbsup: when done.
nash: Smoke tests passed for infra services. :thumbsup:
devtools: Canary rolled to 60% (2024-03-05T18:05Z). Latency within SLOs.
oncall-pager: Alert cleared in us-east-1. Queuing gone after pod recycle.
sre-lead: Rolling note: we will pause rollout at 75% for 20m watch window. If error rate delta >2% over baseline, rollback.
release-bot: Canary progress: api-layer 60% -> 75% (2024-03-05T18:25Z).
julian: Private ops confirmed email scheduled for 19:00 PT. Agent 2.9.0 will be uploaded to the private repo.
nina: Final freeze reminder: no feature merges after Sat 22:00 PT unless exception approved. Emergency path: #release-requests + SRE + Product.
nash: If teams need help validating quantization flags, ping me. I'll pair on tests.
release-bot: Final rollout: api-layer -> 100% (2024-03-05T19:16Z). Post-deploy checks started.
devtools: Post-deploy smoke: all green. Version: release-2024.03.1.
oncall-pager: All alerts cleared. No post-deploy regressions seen.
julian: Sent Private customer advisory + agent upgrade instructions.
nina: Thanks team — train complete. I'll update the release board and close the ticket. :tada:
